mapper.insert:
insert into mp_azure_vm_os_disk ( id, name, size, max_size_gi_b, max_size, max_size_unit, iops, iops_performance_plus, bandwidth_mbps, bandwidth_mbps_performance_plus, max_burst_iops, max_burst_bandwidth_mbps, max_burst_duration_in_min, create_time, update_time ) values
( REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), #{item.name}, #{item.size}, #{item.MaxSizeGiB}, #{item.MaxSize}, #{item.MaxSizeUnit}, #{item.MaxIOps}, #{item.MaxIOpsPerformancePlus}, #{item.MaxBandwidthMBps}, #{item.MaxBandwidthMBpsPerformancePlus}, #{item.MaxBurstIops}, #{item.MaxBurstBandwidthMBps}, #{item.MaxBurstDurationInMin}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT pk, id, name, size, max_size_gi_b, max_size, max_size_unit, iops, iops_performance_plus, bandwidth_mbps, bandwidth_mbps_performance_plus, max_burst_iops, max_burst_bandwidth_mbps, max_burst_duration_in_min FROM ( SELECT pk, id, name, size, max_size_gi_b, max_size, max_size_unit, iops, iops_performance_plus, bandwidth_mbps, bandwidth_mbps_performance_plus, max_burst_iops, max_burst_bandwidth_mbps, max_burst_duration_in_min, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY CAST (SUBSTRING (size, 2, LENGTH (size) - 1) AS INT) ASC) AS rn FROM mp_azure_vm_os_disk ) AS subquery WHERE rn = 1;
